name: @maidelinps/ai-harness-framework
description: A general-purpose AI agent harness framework for building reliable, predictable multi-session engineering workflows

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run e2e
scripts.lint: node scripts/framework-check.mjs lint && node tools/py.mjs -m ruff check . && node tools/py.mjs -m ruff format --check . && node tools/web.mjs lint && node tools/check-docs.mjs
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/framework-check.mjs typecheck && node tools/py.mjs -m mypy && node tools/web.mjs typecheck
scripts.test: node scripts/framework-check.mjs test && node tools/py.mjs -m pytest -q && node tools/web.mjs test
scripts.build: node scripts/framework-check.mjs build && node tools/py.mjs -m compileall -q src && node tools/web.mjs build
scripts.vcr: npm run check && npm run check-arch && node scripts/framework-check.mjs record-trail vcr
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm run check-arch
scripts.lock:backend: node tools/py.mjs -m uv pip compile pyproject.toml --universal --generate-hashes --quiet -o requirements.lock && node tools/py.mjs -m uv pip compile pyproject.toml --extra dev --universal --generate-hashes --quiet -o requirements-dev.lock
scripts.seed: node tools/py.mjs -m invoice_intake.accounts demo && node tools/py.mjs tools/seed_samples.py --samples ../../samples/invoices
scripts.api:types: node tools/py.mjs tools/export_openapi.py && node tools/web.mjs api:types
